text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ai! Reaaally, thank you so much for the 
birthday present! I was super duper 
touched!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
The silk nightcap and tail cover were the 
absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't tangle even when you brush it! 
It's so silky and fluffy!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
What a relief! That solves our morning 
problem, too. Blast always looks like 
she's in pain whenever her coat gets 
tangled.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Its effectiveness has been fully verified 
by yours truly, a regular user. I just 
knew you'd love it!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, that! Right there! What made me the 
happiest was――"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Matching with Ai was the best part of all!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ai and I end up together a lot, like for 
photo shoots and sharing a room, right? 
But we didn't have anything matching, so 
yeah!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I think I might have already decided on 
next year's present.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, matching again? What are you 
matching this time? Can I guess?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, you'll just have to wait! Keep 
looking forward to next year, okay?♪
